title: a16z Podcast: 10+1 Lessons from Serial Entrepreneur Justin Kan

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Want actionable advice from a founder who has built multiple tech companies and has invested the time to be open.
reader_summary.overview: Want actionable advice from a founder who has built multiple tech companies and has invested the time to be open, introspective, and transparent about lessons learned? In this episode (which originally aired as a YouTube video), a16z General Partner Andrew Chen (@@andrewchen) talks with Justin Kan (@justinkan).

key_points.text: Justin is a repeat entrepreneur who co-founded Kiko Software (a Web 2.0 calendar that pre-dated Google Calendar by 4 years).
Justin reflects on his journey and shares 10 + 1 lessons he’s learned: The paradox of choice.
